hypothesis: Waiting for an observed turn down after an extreme BTC notional-share spike avoids entering while BTC leadership is still accelerating.

single_change.rule: Enter when the prior daily dominance z-score was above its rolling 80th-percentile threshold and the one-day dominance change crosses from non-negative to negative; retain the one-bar execution lag.

checks: continuous post-selection net PnL above the frozen baseline

prospective_interpretation_gate.policy: Do not claim reliable performance inference before the minimum number of new prospective entries.
